title: Inventory – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Inventory
hero.lead: An equipment manager or another authorised person records team or club equipment in the inventory. It shows stock, available quantities, active loans and overdue returns.

body:
Select and read an inventory

If you can access several teams or clubs, use the offered team and club filters to select the required inventory. The number below the heading is the item count.

  • Items shows all objects as cards.
  • On loan shows all loans that have not yet been returned.
  • An item card shows the name, category, condition, team or club, available and total quantity and, where present, a description and active loans.
  • The coloured quantity bar indicates the available proportion. A warning identifies at least one overdue return.

Create an item

  1. Select New item, or Create first item in an empty inventory.
  2. Enter the required name.
  3. Add a freely worded category, such as balls, shirts or training equipment.
  4. Select Good, Fair or Poor as the condition, or leave it empty.
  5. Enter the total quantity and select Item, Pair, Set or Kit as the unit.
  6. Add an optional description and internal notes, then select Save.

Edit and delete an item

  • The pencil opens the same fields with their saved values.
  • The bin opens a confirmation prompt containing the item name.
  • The total quantity can be set as low as 0 in the form.

Loan an item

  1. Select Loan on an item card. It is only available when stock is available and you have write permission.
  2. Enter the borrower’s name.
  3. Select a quantity between 1 and the displayed available quantity.
  4. Add an optional return date and note.
  5. Confirm with Loan. The available quantity is reduced immediately.

Record a return

Open On loan or the active loan on the item card. The list shows item, borrower, quantity, loan time, return date and note. Overdue returns are highlighted. Select Mark as returned; Kaderblick then increases the available quantity.

Differences by role

  • Equipment manager: in the verified demo, receives the write view with create, edit, delete, loan and return actions.
  • Club or team managers: receive read or write access according to the inventory permission supplied by the system.
  • Players, parents, coaches and supporters: see the area only when it is enabled for their assignment; write actions require additional permission.
  • Administration: administration rights may grant write access but do not replace selecting the affected team or club inventory.

Related areas

  • Team and club inventories use assignments from Clubs & teams.
  • Outstanding returns remain visible until an authorised person records the return.
